records.part: Underwater camera system (three synchronized sensors, subsea connectivity)
records.reason: the specific C3-PoE SKU proposed for this project is available only from MarineSitu and is not sold through another distribution channel.

records.part: Proprietary software for imaging, processing, and machine-learning model operation
records.reason: MarineSitu confirmed in writing that it is the sole provider and only authorized source for the Mangrove software, SaltySuite™ platform, and project-specific tuned machine-learning models.

records.part: Cloud platform access for storage and review of imagery and detection records
records.reason: Provides access to MarineSitu's proprietary SaltySuite™ cloud platform for storage and review of system imagery and detection records.

records.part: Project-specific machine-learning model for shrimp sizing (head/tail detection)
records.reason: Shrimp sizing machine-learning model – MarineSitu's model architecture, training pipeline, and methods are proprietary; the project deliverable will consist of a model specifically tuned for shrimp at the USM research site and operated within the MarineSitu software environment.

records.part: Project-specific machine-learning model for spawning-behavior detection
records.reason: Shrimp behavior machine-learning model – MarineSitu's model architecture and methods are proprietary, and the project-specific model will operate within the MarineSitu environment.

records.part: Industrial control computer for imaging system, validated with Mangrove software
records.reason: The industrial control computer specified by MarineSitu is based on the commercially available NVIDIA AGX Orin platform.

records.part: Cabling terminated for compatibility with the C3 camera system
records.reason: portions of the cabling are commodity components terminated for compatibility with the C3 system.
